body:
Continuation of incomplete draft PR #1165, roadmap Tasks 10–12. Depends on paired-host transport/realtime issues.

## Scope
- Replace inherited four-tab navigation with Agents / Tools / Settings
- Build all/project-filtered chats and active/completed/archived views
- Support create/open/rename/archive/restore/fork/delete, child sessions, approvals/questions, diffs/todos/files/terminal
- Add reconnect dedupe and authoritative refresh
- Add unified Activity feed across human, scheduler, webhook, research, cookbook, and optimizer executions

## Acceptance
- Existing reusable chat/workspace/terminal components are reused rather than duplicated
- Offline caches are secret-free/read-only and mutations disable offline
- Activity aggregation creates no duplicate execution table
- Loading/empty/offline/auth/error states and Dynamic Type/dark mode/accessibility pass
- API/mobile tests and independent reviews pass
title: iOS: deliver Agents navigation, chats, recovery, and Activity
